components.name: Solid button
components.description: The main action: a gold pill that lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.7rem 2rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; font: 600 1rem 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; background: #d9b24a; color: #050505; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0.8rem 2rem -0.8rem rgb(217 178 74 / 0.8); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.25s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f4d98a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4d98a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: The second action: a glass pill with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-ghost { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.7rem 2rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); font: 600 1rem 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #f3ead3; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.25s; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: rgb(217 178 74 / 0.7); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4d98a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass stat
components.description: A glass panel holding one rolling number and its label.
components.css: .ds-stat { width: 14rem; padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem 1.3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; border-radius: 1.4rem; background: rgb(20 18 12 / 0.42); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), 0 1.8rem 3rem -1.8rem rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(150%); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.3s; } .ds-stat:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgb(217 178 74 / 0.45); } .ds-stat b { font: 800 2.6rem/1.25 'Alexandria', sans-serif; color: #f4d98a; direction: ltr; text-align: end; } .ds-stat span { font: 0.92rem/1.6 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; color: rgb(243 234 211 / 0.8); }

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Sort switch: a pill track with one solid gold segment.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; min-height: 2.4rem; border-radius: 999px; font: 0.9rem 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; color: rgb(243 234 211 / 0.8); transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.3s; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #f3ead3; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4d98a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #d9b24a; color: #050505; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Rank row
components.description: A leaderboard row: rank, company, bar and value. Opens the company sheet.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.6rem 13rem minmax(6rem, 1fr) 4rem; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; width: 34rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); color: #f3ead3; cursor: pointer; text-align: start; transition: background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: rgb(217 178 74 / 0.09); border-color: rgb(217 178 74 / 0.4); transform: translateX(-4px); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4d98a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rk { font: 800 1.1rem 'Alexandria', sans-serif; color: #d9b24a; text-align: center; } .ds-nm b { display: block; font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Alexandria', sans-serif; } .ds-nm span { font: 0.8rem 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; color: rgb(243 234 211 / 0.62); } .ds-bar { position: relative; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); direction: ltr; } .ds-bar i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #d9b24a, #f4d98a); } .ds-vl { font: 600 1rem 'Alexandria', sans-serif; text-align: end; direction: ltr; }

narrative.northStar: A night-market screen: black, gold, cream, glass, always moving.
narrative.overview: Muashir is a night-market screen: a black ground, gold price lines drifting behind everything, cream text, and glass panels that hold the content. The page moves from the first frame and keeps copy to a line or two per section. The owner set the bar as their own Cerebra and Sila sites, so motion, glass and short copy are requirements.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed canvas of drifting gold price lines behind every section
Glass panels with blur, hairline border and a pointer-following gold spotlight
Word-by-word headings, odometer numbers, drawn charts
A sticky stage that changes scene as the reader scrolls
Tools first: leaderboard, two-company duel, guessing game, company sheet, Ctrl+K search

rules.name: Gold is the only brand colour
rules.body: Green and red never decorate; they mean up and down, and always carry a sign or an arrow.

rules.name: One or two lines per section
rules.body: Method and limits live in collapsed panels.

rules.name: Glass is never nested
rules.body: One glass panel per block of content.

dos: Do keep the background moving and the copy short.
Do give every number a sign or a unit.
Do open new detail in the sheet or the stage before adding a section.
donts: Don't add a second brand colour or a light section.
Don't write a paragraph where a number and a line will do.
Don't show a figure that is not in the pipeline's output.
